name: codex-extras
description: Codex conversations in Agent Work Plan's work plan and Conversations views, a Codex session list, and a Codex button on the tab bar.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode nothing is installed into Codex, Codex is not patched and no file is written.

commands.title: Codex Extras: Install the Work Plan Plugin into Codex
Codex Extras: Trust the Work Plan Hooks in Codex
Codex Extras: Remove the Work Plan Plugin from Codex
Codex Extras: New Codex Conversation in a Tab
Codex Extras: New Codex Conversation in the Sidebar
Codex Extras: List Conversations from Every Folder

codexExtras.codexHome.markdownDescription: The Codex home directory to read and to install the work plan plugin into. Empty uses `CODEX_HOME` when it is set, otherwise `~/.codex`.

codexExtras.workPlan.markdownDescription: Keep a work plan for each Codex conversation: the open rows put in front of the model every turn, and the reminders at the end of one. Agent Work Plan draws the plans. Off makes the hooks say nothing and refuse to change a plan, and no Codex plan is shown.

codexExtras.installWorkPlanPlugin.markdownDescription: Whether to install the work plan plugin into Codex when it is missing or older than the one this extension ships.
enumDescriptions: Ask once per Codex home and plugin version
Install without asking; Codex still asks you to trust its hooks
Never install it; use the command

codexExtras.sessionList.markdownDescription: Show the **Codex sessions** view in the Codex Extras sidebar: the conversations open in this window, recently closed ones, and the rest by Codex's own sections.

codexExtras.sessionsInWorkspaceOnly.markdownDescription: List only conversations started in this window's workspace folders, or folders under them, in Codex sessions (open and recently closed ones are always listed).

codexExtras.hideBackgroundSessions.markdownDescription: Leave out the threads Codex starts by itself - sub-agents and the reviews of approval requests - and `codex exec` runs.

codexExtras.recentClosedSessions.markdownDescription: How many conversations **Recently closed** lists. 0 hides it.

codexExtras.reopenDroppedTabs.markdownDescription: Reopen the Codex tabs that were open when the window closed but that VS Code did not restore, as can happen after the window lost its remote connection. Tabs you closed while connected stay closed.

enumDescriptions: The Codex conversation last in front, in a tab; a new one in a tab when there is none
codexExtras.openButtonTarget.markdownDescription: What the Codex button on the tab bar opens.

codexExtras.tellCodexYourTimeZone.markdownDescription: Tell Codex the time zone you read in, when it differs from the machine Codex runs on, so it gives you times in your zone. The zone is the one Codex's page runs in.

codexExtras.workPlanOfferMinTurns.markdownDescription: How many messages you must have sent before a conversation without a plan is offered one.

codexExtras.workPlanOfferMinToolCalls.markdownDescription: How many tool calls one turn must make before that offer.

codexExtras.workPlanQuietWhenReplyMatche.markdownDescription: A regular expression (Python syntax) tested on the latest reply. A match silences the reminders around a compaction, for conversations relaying another model's replies word for word.

codexExtras.patchCodex.markdownDescription: Whether to patch the Codex extension's own files for the additions that need it: status dots on Codex tabs, opening a given conversation in the sidebar, answers put into a conversation's message box, chimes and the line of turn figures. Codex's originals are kept beside them and put back by **Codex Extras: Remove the Patch from Codex** or on uninstall.

codexExtras.chime.markdownDescription: With the patch: a short sound in a Codex tab when a turn there finishes or its work plan asks you something.

codexExtras.turnFigures.markdownDescription: With the patch: a line at the bottom right of a Codex tab with the last turn's duration, context use, model and effort, and the tool call running now.
